verdict.rationale: Unleash exposes a comprehensive Admin API for programmatic management (unleash-docs-6), API/backend tokens explicitly designed for automation and non-interactive SDK/Edge access (unleash-docs-23, unleash-docs-34), and self-hosted Docker deployment (unleash-docs-4) enabling fully headless operation without the Admin UI. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), a documented CLI tool, or Terraform/IaC provider for flag management in automation workflows.
